## Authorization Process

1. **Submission**: This request will be validated automatically for format compliance
2. **GGC Review**: Global Governance Council (7-of-9 multisig) will review your credentials
3. **Geographic Check**: Ensures geographic diversity is maintained (no region >40%)
4. **DID Verification**: Confirms uniqueness and validity of your DID
5. **Authorization**: If approved, you'll be added to TFKVerifier.authorizedEFAs mapping

**Expected Timeline**: 7-14 days

---

## Requirements (SAIN Protocol Section V)

- ✅ **Proof-of-Sovereignty (PoS)**: Verifiable Credential from accredited EF
- ✅ **Geographic Diversity**: ZKP attestation of continent-level location
- ✅ **Singular Node Ownership**: Maximum 1 SAN per EFA DID
- ✅ **Non-Anonymity Index**: Public key linked to registered DID
